versions.localizedDescription:
App that let you scan the barcodes of food and personal care items to instantly learn about their health impacts. It provides a rating and detailed information for a thorough analysis of each product. Note: The search feature is currently not working and a premium subscription popup appears every time the app is opened which may be somewhat bothersome.
Last updated: 07-23-2024
Status: ✅ 👍 ⭐
